project_info.theme: Galaxy S26 Ultra multitasking feature poster
project_info.color_palette: White, deep blue-violet, pastel widget colors, black text

main_subject.detail: Minimal white-background product poster featuring a front-facing blue-violet Galaxy S26 Ultra showing a widget-rich home screen with Sleep score, Steps, calendar, and Now brief modules, paired with campaign copy about being a multitasking beast.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic premium smartphone render, clean UI-led launch poster

composition_elements.text: This is who you asked to / Be a multitasking beast
items: Top Left: Large white negative space with small black copy at mid-left reading 'This is who you asked to Be a multitasking beast'.
Top Right: Floating front-facing blue-violet Galaxy S26 Ultra with centered punch-hole camera.
Bottom Left: Home-screen widgets including Sleep score '92 Excellent' and Steps '4,350 /6,000'.
Bottom Right: 'Now brief' widget and app dock icons along the lower edge of the screen.
Center/Background: The phone screen also shows a July calendar and a lounge-chair illustration, all on a bright minimalist white field.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean glass reflections, bright UI legibility, airy premium ecommerce tone

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy S26 Ultra multitasking feature poster. Centerpiece is a front-facing blue-violet Galaxy S26 Ultra floating on a white background, displaying a modular widget home screen with Sleep score '92 Excellent', Steps '4,350 /6,000', a July calendar, and a 'Now brief' tile. Background is minimal white with substantial negative space. Surrounding elements: exact side copy 'This is who you asked to Be a multitasking beast'. Technical style: photorealistic product render, soft studio lighting, clean glass reflections and bright UI legibility, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
